description: The source request (spec/cli/sources.md, section 4). This folder is a project with three connections: erp (sqlserver, its database given in metadata.with from a value of each environment), crm (salesforce by default, without the instanceUrl input) and landing (files, covered by sources/landing.yaml). Its recipes are in its own recipes/ folder. Each case runs the request for environment (none when left out, which resolves for the first environment project.yaml declares) and connection (none when left out), with no environment variables set; expected names the file holding the exact Markdown, and resolved says whether the definitions resolved.

requests.name: every connection a flow reads, for dev
a schema part that is an unset environment variable keeps {schemas} to fill in
no environment: resolved for dev, the first environment project.yaml declares, which the title names; the import lines carry no --env
